title: Hajj & Umrah Guide: The Fifth Pillar of Islam
description: A practical and spiritual guide to Hajj and Umrah from the Salafi texts: Al-Mughni by Imam Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab Manhaj As-Salikeen (the rulings of Hajj) and a complete step-by-step description of Hajj by Shaykh Sulayman al-Ruhayli. Taught by Ustadh AbdulAziz al-Haqqan (Garden of Ilm).
short_description: Rulings and description of Hajj and Umrah step by step

modules.title: The Book of Hajj — Manhaj As-Salikeen
modules.description: The rulings of Hajj from the text Manhaj As-Salikeen by Ibn Abd al-Wahhab, with the commentary of Sheikh Sulayman al-Ruhayli, taught by Ustadh AbdulAziz al-Haqqan.

lessons.title: The Book of Hajj | Lesson 1 — Manhaj As-Salikeen
lessons.content: The virtues of Hajj and Umrah, and who must perform them. source: Garden of Ilm (https://www.youtube.com/@gardenofilm) - Ustadh AbdulAziz al-Haqqan

lessons.title: The Book of Hajj | Lesson 2 — Manhaj As-Salikeen
lessons.content: The conditions of Hajj and which Hajj is obligatory upon whom. source: Garden of Ilm (https://www.youtube.com/@gardenofilm) - Ustadh AbdulAziz al-Haqqan

lessons.title: The Book of Hajj | Lesson 3 — Manhaj As-Salikeen
lessons.content: The pillars and obligatory acts of Hajj. source: Garden of Ilm (https://www.youtube.com/@gardenofilm) - Ustadh AbdulAziz al-Haqqan

lessons.title: The Book of Hajj | Lesson 4 — Manhaj As-Salikeen
lessons.content: The rulings of ihram: entering it, its prohibitions, and the miqat points. source: Garden of Ilm (https://www.youtube.com/@gardenofilm) - Ustadh AbdulAziz al-Haqqan

lessons.content: The rites of Makkah: tawaf, sa'i, and the day of Arafah. source: Garden of Ilm (https://www.youtube.com/@gardenofilm) - Ustadh AbdulAziz al-Haqqan

lessons.content: The remaining rites of Hajj: ramy (stoning), sacrifice and cutting of hair. source: Garden of Ilm (https://www.youtube.com/@gardenofilm) - Ustadh AbdulAziz al-Haqqan

lessons.content: Umrah and completing the pilgrimage. source: Garden of Ilm (https://www.youtube.com/@gardenofilm) - Ustadh AbdulAziz al-Haqqan
